question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be known fully?
premises: There is a division of eight octads
This division is an object of inquiry
Complete knowledge of it is desired
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: The adverb anantathā may qualify the extent or manner of knowing.
plain_english: And to know fully, without end, the division of the eight octads.
